topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Rain was spitting on the window, like it had a mouthful of dime-store regrets to spit out. Got the call. The surprise party, it was off. Figures. Rainy nights bring lies to the surface—lies like how much you're needed or how happy folks are to see you. Cancelled. Just like that. The phone went dead. Didn't listen to the static much longer. Every flash of lightning showed the shadows in the room a little too clearly. Maybe it's for the best. Less people to lie to, fewer smiles to watch for cracks. Rain kept tapping, a relentless witness to the quiet room and the even quieter heart.
